title: US officials: the Trump administration's decision to impose export controls on Anthropic followed multiple tense calls between Dario Amodei and admin officials (Politico)
summary: Politico: US officials: the Trump administration's decision to impose export controls on Anthropic followed multiple tense calls between Dario Amodei and admin officials — The administration's imposition of export controls forced Anthropic to pull its new AI model, Fable, just days after it was released to the public.
